Thanks a lot for the mods, I’m relatively new to Tarkov, having played half a wipe, two wipes ago and only recently having found SPT, and it’s nice to have some prebuilt modded guns to play around with.

Ok,

comments.author: Reis
comments.body_html:
Man, I think everything is fine with your game. I just need to explain how the mod works. Let’s go:

You already know that Priscilu Special Weapons is a pack of weapons. But, what I think you don’t know is that this mod does not create new weapons. This mod just upgrades some weapons. So, there are no new weapons, just upgraded ones. That is why there is no HK 416 P1 on your game. Once the mod is installed, the HK 416A5 turns into the upgraded version that we call HK 416 P1. But, officially, in the game, there is no HK 416 P1, even when the mod is installed. It is just a name we use to talk about the upgraded version of the HK 416A5.

The Older Priscilu Special Weapons indeed created new weapons, but the new version, doesn’t. It was a decision we make because players were facing issues when uninstalling the old mod. The way it is now, there will be no issue in uninstalling it.

Hope it helps, man.

See you.
